facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Guaranteed Capital: Yes for selected teams; exact deal varies by accelerator
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Core investment accelerators generally invest around US$100K over 12 weeks; specific programs vary (e.g. $100K for 7.5% SAFE, direct current-round investment, uncapped note, or up to $200K in Saudi).
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Program-specific; many current programs use $100K for 7.5% SAFE, while others use current-round or convertible-note structures.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: High-growth startup; geography/vertical and relocation requirements depend on selected accelerator.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 US multi-city 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: split child records before making exact deal/relocation recommendations.
